text.p: Alcatel Alsthom continued its share price recovery on Wednesday, which started at the end of last week, benefiting from the dollar rise and from a growing realisation the share is undervalued, dealers said.
CDC Bourse had increased its recommendation to buy on Tuesday, seeing a rise to 500 francs.

Fund managers also noted a rumour that two major brokerages were doing big block deals for several tens of thousands of shares. At 1237 GMT, Alcatel was up 3.31 percent at 471 francs in a market which was up 1.59 percent. Turnover in Alcatel was 419 million francs.
Gilbert Ferrand of CDC said he expected a 22.60 francs earnings per share figure for 1997 and 39.10 for 1998, against 5.40 francs for 1996.
